response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN inv.cost_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A line's ratio is treated as missing when derived_product_cost is NULL, derived_total_cost is NULL, or derived_total_cost is 0 (NULLIF avoids division by zero), so such lines are ignored in the average.
The number of line items is the count of all Invoice_Line_Items rows for the invoice, including rows whose ratio is missing.
The overall average is the unweighted average of the per-invoice cost ratios, as the request states, and not an average over all lines.
